notes.title: Version 0.0.181
notes.notes:
Improved FPS performance

Fox Merchants added for map T2

Attack speed events added

New models and icons

Increased number of enemies in maps T1 and T2

Social media links added to main menu

Fullscreen option added to main menu

Resolution settings added to main menu

Forest elite appearance updated

Forest elite made stronger

Elite Elemental made stronger, damage type changed to piercing

Arrow Speed and Hourglass events now respawn

Boon: Dash can now deal damage

Boon: Q ability replenishes Golden Quiver

Fixed boon with arrows so they no longer clone arrows; damage boost increased from 20 to 30

New boon “Plasma” attacks at cursor, piercing damage 2×5, and can be upgraded

All random events redesigned for improved accuracy in code

New building: Armory

Armor items (helm, boots, veil) added with new player stats

Arcane Scroll redesigned

Enemy spawner speed increased

Boons and items rebalanced (buffs and nerfs)

Totem shop added

notes.title: Update 0.0.180 – New Version of Balladrion is Here!
notes.notes:
​Added a new map called T2 Forest

Introduced a new enemy: Crow

Crow now has a dash mechanic that targets the player

Fire Element now shoots fireballs in four directions

Cooldowns now display visually when abilities are ready

Cooldowns now play a sound to notify the player

New UI for health, stamina, Q ability, and dash

Polished jewelry UI

Nerfed the stamina boon

Nerfed stamina from 5 to 2

Added new boon: lifesteal for arrows (testing only)

Added new boon: double damage chance for arrows (testing only)

Forest elite enemy is now larger

Random events no longer apply slow effect

Fixed popup icon positions

Added trails for arrows, goblin arrows, Q spell, and piercing arrow

Added new player UI icon

Updated main menu with a well, crow, potion, and arrow

Potion is now visible on the player character

Added UI popup for full inventory

Added new boon: PlusArrow

Added new boon: XArrow

Game now recognizes all materials: gold, wood, stone, herb, frozen wood, infernite, glacius, duskore, dreamore, and scrolls

Added new icon for DreamOre

Fixed issues with crows

Fixed issues with tickets

notes.title: All updates done in 6 months till VERSION 0.0157
notes.notes:
Dynamic enemy generation added with goblins and wolves spawning procedurally for varied gameplay.,
 Minimap system implemented showing player and enemy icons for better navigation.,
 Item pickup mechanic created; inventory management and XP progression introduced for character growth.,
 UI overhaul: health, stamina, XP bars, quest progress, inventory grid, pause and death menus added.,
 Multiple new levels/environments: Town, Forest, Graveyard with smooth map transitions and loading logic.,
 Performance optimized via static lighting, asset cleanup; stable 60 FPS on test hardware; project size reduced.,
 Shooting system redesigned with arrow objects and Niagara VFX for visual impact.,
 Enemy AI enhanced with improved behavior, attack animations, visibility (colored models), and unstuck logic.,
 Player interaction features added: F-key interactions, teleportation via obelisks, and UI feedback on actions.,
 Map selection system introduced with smooth transitions and refined visuals.,
 Inventory and resource icons properly scaled and clear for better UI clarity.,
 UI resolution compatibility ensured for 1980x display with correct ESC and menu handling.,
 Advanced Niagara visual effects added for fire and shooting; FPS limit unlocked for smooth gameplay.,
 Expanded world design with buildings, fences, props, windmills, tavern, and combat dummies for immersion.,
 Cooldown timer system for abilities and dash; bow shop and forgery systems fully implemented.,
 Companion mechanics added with passive foxes providing buffs (map reveal, inventory aid).,
 Inventory auto-expands on upgrade; enemies visible on map; UI and cooldown display bugs fixed.,
 Health and stamina potions upgradable and maxable.,
 New stats tracked: deaths, enemies killed, successful runs.,
 Spawn system revamped: enemies spawn farther away; AI uses chase only; no freezing.,
 Enemies stop to attack, flash red when hit, have individual pathing; elite enemies added.,
 Timer and boon systems added for gameplay events; game pause mechanics improved.,
 Cutscenes and memories system added; quests replaced with map-oriented story events.,
 New abilities added: defense shield with rotating disks, health regeneration with upgrades.,
 Ability skill levels now shown on UI.,
 New goblin archer enemy with ranged attacks and timed shooting.,
 Final project adjustments for Balladrion and Steam packaging.
